<definitions xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="node-timer-definitions" targetNamespace="https://elsa-workflows.io/schemas/bpmn" xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:elsa="https://elsa-workflows.io/schemas/bpmn">
  <process id="node-timer" isExecutable="true">
    <startEvent id="start">
      <outgoing>first</outgoing>
    </startEvent>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="wait">
      <incoming>first</incoming>
      <outgoing>last</outgoing>
      <timerEventDefinition>
        <timeDuration>PT5S</timeDuration>
      </timerEventDefinition>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <endEvent id="end">
      <incoming>last</incoming>
    </endEvent>
    <sequenceFlow id="first" sourceRef="start" targetRef="wait" />
    <sequenceFlow id="last" sourceRef="wait" targetRef="end" />
  </process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="node-timer-diagram">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="node-timer-plane" bpmnElement="node-timer">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="start_di" bpmnElement="start">
        <dc:Bounds x="40" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="wait_di" bpmnElement="wait">
        <dc:Bounds x="156" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="end_di" bpmnElement="end">
        <dc:Bounds x="272" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="first_di" bpmnElement="first">
        <di:waypoint x="76" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="156" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="last_di" bpmnElement="last">
        <di:waypoint x="192" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="272" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</definitions>

<definitions xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="node-publisher-definitions" targetNamespace="https://elsa-workflows.io/schemas/bpmn" xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:elsa="https://elsa-workflows.io/schemas/bpmn">
  <signal id="signal-bpmn-adoption-e228a06a322148e7b287b4d7eddc2c83" name="bpmn-adoption-e228a06a322148e7b287b4d7eddc2c83" />
  <process id="node-publisher" isExecutable="true">
    <startEvent id="start">
      <outgoing>begin</outgoing>
    </startEvent>
    <intermediateThrowEvent id="send">
      <incoming>begin</incoming>
      <outgoing>finish</outgoing>
      <signalEventDefinition signalRef="signal-bpmn-adoption-e228a06a322148e7b287b4d7eddc2c83" />
    </intermediateThrowEvent>
    <endEvent id="end">
      <incoming>finish</incoming>
    </endEvent>
    <sequenceFlow id="begin" sourceRef="start" targetRef="send" />
    <sequenceFlow id="finish" sourceRef="send" targetRef="end" />
  </process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="node-publisher-diagram">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="node-publisher-plane" bpmnElement="node-publisher">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="start_di" bpmnElement="start">
        <dc:Bounds x="40" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="send_di" bpmnElement="send">
        <dc:Bounds x="156" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="end_di" bpmnElement="end">
        <dc:Bounds x="272" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="begin_di" bpmnElement="begin">
        <di:waypoint x="76" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="156" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="finish_di" bpmnElement="finish">
        <di:waypoint x="192" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="272" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</definitions>
